scope: User-prioritized delivery: completed 1172-question Ouro ARC reproduction and offline 600-question Qwen discovery analysis. Independent GPU evaluation deferred by user.
primary_endpoint: Question-level accuracy difference of the nested-CV linear gate versus Always Euler; all 600 questions, including unchanged and both-wrong predictions.
positive_class_for_auc: Beneficial g=+1; harmful g=-1 is negative. Binary AUC is descriptive and excludes g=0; policy accuracy includes every question.
fold_stratification: g in {-1,0,+1}, seed 2021; all IDs assigned to a fold before fitting; model fitting includes every changed prediction in training, including g=0.
linear_estimator: Ridge regression of g, unweighted, fitted on changed predictions only; train-fold median imputation and train-fold StandardScaler; accept if predicted gain > threshold.
model_selection: Maximize inner out-of-fold sum of g*accept. Tie: smaller threshold, then stronger regularization. No AUC feature selection.
gate_selection: On development/training changed predictions only: both signs, 11 training quantiles and always/never; maximize g*accept. Prefer always Euler on ties, then fewer rejections. No test-fold thresholds.
cross_dataset: Leave each of ARC, OpenBookQA and the five-subject MMLU pool out; fit on the other two groups. This is discovery-set cross-task validation, not fresh held-out evidence.
bootstrap: Question-level paired percentile bootstrap, seed2021. Policy CIs condition on fixed fitted/OOF decisions and do not include model-selection uncertainty. AUC uses stratified resampling of beneficial and harmful examples.
mcnemar: Exact two-sided binomial test on discordant correctness counts.
random_controls: Fixed hash-based random feature; training-label permutation for linear model; original/euler confidence only; dataset prior. For each fitted gate, a task-stratified acceptance-count-matched random gate plus10000 randomizations, no labels used in acceptance draws.
multiplicity: All univariate associations exploratory; Holm-adjusted Mann-Whitney p-values reported. Linear-versus-Euler is the sole primary policy comparison; other policy tests exploratory.
independent_test: Not run in this delivery. No claim of independent confirmation or deployment GO is allowed.
online_cost: Existing A0+A3 elapsed times summed, explicitly historical serial measurements, not a fresh shared-compute benchmark; CPU predictor overhead measured separately. No speedup claim.
